description.text: At Rehabana, we are committed to protecting your personal, medical, and digital information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and safeguard your data while ensuring transparency, confidentiality, and ethical care at every step.

details.text:
Welcome to Rehabana.
Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, protect, and manage personal and medical information when you visit our website or receive services from us.
By using our services or website, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
Information We Collect
We may collect the following types of information:
Personal Information
Name, age, gender, contact details
Address, email ID, phone number
Medical Information
Medical history, diagnosis, reports, prescriptions
Therapy progress notes and assessments
Website & Digital Information
IP address, browser type, device data
Website usage behavior through cookies or analytics tools
How We Use Your Information
Your information is used strictly to:
Provide safe, effective, and customized rehabilitation care
Schedule appointments and communicate treatment updates
Maintain accurate medical records
Improve our services, website, and patient experience
Comply with legal, ethical, and regulatory obligations
We do not sell or rent your personal or medical information to third parties.
Confidentiality of Medical Records
All patient medical records are handled with strict confidentiality and accessed only by authorized medical professionals and staff involved in your care.
Any sharing of medical information occurs only with patient consent or when required by law.
Cookies & Website Tracking
Our website may use cookies to:
Improve functionality and user experience
Understand visitor behavior and website performance
You may disable cookies through your browser settings, though some features may be affected.
Data Security
We take reasonable technical and administrative measures to protect your data against:
Unauthorized access
Loss, misuse, or alteration
Despite best efforts, no digital system is completely secure. We continuously work to improve data protection practices.
Third-Party Services
We may use trusted third-party tools for:
Website analytics
Email communication
Appointment scheduling
These service providers are required to maintain confidentiality and comply with data protection standards.
Patient Rights
You have the right to:
Access your personal and medical information
Request correction of inaccurate data
Withdraw consent for non-essential communication
Requests can be made by contacting us through official channels.
Children’s Privacy
Our services may involve minors. In such cases, personal and medical data is collected only with the consent of parents or legal guardians.
Data Retention
Patient data is retained only for as long as necessary to:
Provide medical care
Meet legal and regulatory requirements
After this period, data is securely archived or disposed of.
Changes to This Policy

Rehabana reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy periodically.
Any changes will be reflected on this page with the updated date.
Continued use of our services implies acceptance of the revised policy.
Contact Information
If you have questions, concerns, or requests related to this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the phone number or email provided on our website.

details.text: Our Vision
Restoring Mobility. Rebuilding Lives.

At Rehabana, our vision is to see every patient achieve meaningful mobility and independence guided by expert care, advanced science, and unwavering compassion.
We believe recovery is not just about movement, but about confidence, dignity, and living life fully again.
Our Mission
To make advanced neuro rehabilitation accessible and affordable for every individual improving mobility, confidence, and quality of life through medical science, technology, and compassionate care.
What We Stand For
Compassionate Care
We treat every patient with empathy, patience, and respect—supporting emotional wellbeing alongside physical recovery.
Neuro-Scientific Approach
Our rehab programs are rooted in neuroscience, using robotic rehabilitation, task-specific training, and evidence-based techniques for better outcomes.
Empowering Families
We educate and involve caregivers at every step, enabling sustainable recovery at home and long-term independence for patients.
The Future of Rehabilitation in India
Our Future Vision

Rehabana strives to become the most trusted name in neuro rehabilitation in Eastern India, combining clinical excellence with continuous innovation.
Our goal is to extend quality rehab beyond clinic walls by reaching communities that need it most.
We aim to achieve this through:
Community outreach and home-based rehabilitation programs
Tele-rehabilitation and digital therapy platforms
Training programs for physiotherapists and caregivers
Research collaborations to advance rehabilitation science
Our journey continues—because recovery deserves no limits.
Join Our Mission of Empowerment

Whether you’re a patient, caregiver, or healthcare partner, your journey matters.
Together, we can transform rehabilitation into a path of strength, confidence, and independence.
Get in touch and take the first step forward.

description.text: These Terms & Conditions outline the guidelines for using Rehabana’s services and website. They ensure transparency, mutual respect, and a safe, informed rehabilitation experience for patients, caregivers, and partners.

details.text:
Welcome to Rehabana.
By accessing our website, facilities, or services, you agree to comply with the following Terms & Conditions. These are designed to ensure transparency, safety, and clarity for all patients, caregivers, and partners.
Medical Disclaimer

All information on this website is for general awareness and educational purposes only.
It does not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Rehabilitation outcomes vary for each individual based on medical condition, severity, and response to therapy.
Treatment & Outcomes
Rehab programs are doctor-led and customized, but recovery timelines and results cannot be guaranteed.
Progress depends on medical condition, consistency, participation, and individual health factors.
No content on this website should be interpreted as a promise of cure or specific outcomes.
Appointments & Consultations
Appointments are subject to availability and prior confirmation.
Missed or cancelled sessions may be governed by clinic policies communicated at the time of booking.
Doctor evaluations and therapy plans are decided based on clinical judgment.
Payments & Fees
All fees must be paid as per the agreed treatment plan and schedule.
Fees once paid are generally non-refundable, unless stated otherwise in writing.
Rehabana reserves the right to revise pricing with prior communication.
Patient Responsibilities
Patients and caregivers are expected to:
Share accurate medical history and reports
Follow prescribed rehab plans and safety instructions
Maintain respectful behavior toward staff and other patients
Failure to comply may affect therapy outcomes or continuation of services.
Use of Website
Website content may not be copied, reproduced, or misused without written permission.
Any misuse, hacking, or attempt to disrupt services is strictly prohibited.
Rehabana is not responsible for third-party links or external websites.
Privacy & Confidentiality
Patient data, medical records, and personal information are handled with strict confidentiality, in accordance with applicable privacy laws and ethical medical standards.
Limitation of Liability
Rehabana shall not be held liable for:
Indirect or incidental damages
Outcomes beyond clinical control
Decisions made based on website content without medical consultation
Policy Updates

These Terms & Conditions may be updated periodically.
Continued use of services implies acceptance of the latest version.
Contact Information
For questions or clarifications regarding these Terms & Conditions, please contact us directly through our official phone number or email listed on the website.
